title.en: Ulugh Beg in a London edition

alt.en: A bordered title page uses large Latin capitals, naming Ulug Beigi and Johannes Gravius above a London imprint dated 1650.
alt.zh: 带边框的扉页使用大型拉丁字母，在1650年伦敦出版信息上方列出Ulug Beigi与Johannes Gravius之名。

caption.en: Epochae celebriores, edited and annotated by John Greaves, London, 1650; title page. Wellcome Collection.
caption.zh: 《著名纪元》，约翰·格里夫斯编辑并注释，伦敦，1650年；扉页。惠康收藏。

interpretation.en: This Persian-and-Latin edition makes a later stage of transmission visible through its editor, languages and imprint. It is not a manuscript from Ulugh Beg’s observatory.
interpretation.zh: 此波斯文与拉丁文版本以编辑、语言及出版信息展现后世传播的一环，并非兀鲁伯天文台的手稿。

note.en: The item’s full IIIF manifest explicitly marks the work Public Domain and permits commercial and noncommercial reuse.
note.zh: 单件完整IIIF清单明确标为公共领域，允许商业及非商业再利用。

transformation.en: Official image saved unchanged, retaining stamps and page margins.
transformation.zh: 原样保存官方图像，保留印章与纸边。

alt.en: An English title page reads The Travels of Ibn Batuta, with translator Samuel Lee’s name, a circular library stamp and the date 1829.
alt.zh: 英文扉页写有《伊本·白图泰游记》、译者塞缪尔·李之名、圆形图书馆印章及1829年。

caption.en: The Travels of Ibn Batuta, translated by Samuel Lee, London, 1829; title page. Royal College of Physicians, digitized through Wellcome Collection.
caption.zh: 《伊本·白图泰游记》，塞缪尔·李译，伦敦，1829年；扉页。皇家内科医师学会藏，经惠康收藏数字化提供。

interpretation.en: The title explicitly identifies abridged Arabic manuscript copies as the basis of the translation. It records later mediation, not a complete or unedited travel diary.
interpretation.zh: 扉页明确说明译本依据阿拉伯文节本手稿，记录的是后世转译，而非完整、未经编辑的旅行日记。

title.en: Riel among the provisional government’s councillors
title.zh: 临时政府议员中的里尔

alt.en: A black-and-white group photograph shows men seated and standing in rows, with a dark handwritten mark above the central seated man.
alt.zh: 黑白合影中，男子分排站立或就座，中央坐着的男子上方留有深色手写标记。

caption.en: Louis Riel and companions, 1870; councillors of the Métis provisional government. Lakehead University Library, General Archives–88c.
caption.zh: 《路易·里尔与同伴》，1870年；梅蒂斯人临时政府议员。湖首大学图书馆，General Archives–88c。

interpretation.en: The archive identifies Riel at the centre. The group setting places leadership beside fellow councillors; the handwritten mark belongs to this surviving photographic copy.
interpretation.zh: 档案将中央人物识别为里尔。群体构图把领导者与其他议员并置；手写标记是这份存世照片副本的一部分。
